name: Lose the Heat
summary: Lose the Heat is a 3D arcade driving and police pursuit browser game, and the first installment in the Lose the Heat series. Set in the semi-open city of Crabby Valley, Lose the Heat puts players behind the wheel of a muscle car as a getaway driver for hire. Picking up missions from the local bar patrons, players must navigate city streets, evade relentless police pursuits, trigger environmental destruction traps, and reach designated extraction zones before it's too late to do so.
